relevant.reason: UAS activity active during the flight window, located 9.9 nm left of the track, within 1 nm radius, up to 400 ft AGL. Could be a hazard if the track deviates or if the UAS is encountered.
relevant.summary: There is a drone (UAS) operating within 640 m of a point near Eemshaven, active 10:00-15:00Z on 23 Sep. It is about 10 nm left of your planned track, up to 400 ft AGL. Avoid the area or maintain extra vigilance.

relevant.reason: Revised opening hours at departure aerodrome EHGG: closed on weekends and holidays after 1900, and PPR required for traffic between 1900-2000. The flight window is 0700-1600Z, so it is open, but the PPR requirement for late departures is relevant if the pilot plans to depart after 1900 local (which is 1700Z? Actually local time is UTC+2, so 1900 local = 1700Z, outside the window). However, the NOTAM is at the departure aerodrome and affects operating hours, so it is relevant.
relevant.summary: Groningen Airport Eelde has revised opening hours: on Saturdays, Sundays and holidays it is open 0530-1900 local. Traffic between 1900-2000 local requires PPR 48 hours in advance. Your planned window is within these hours, but be aware if your departure is delayed.
